description: This source file defines the Cloud9Client class for interacting with the AWS Cloud9 service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various Cloud9 operations, indicating both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: Cloud9Client
classes.description: A client class for the AWS Cloud9 service enabling creation, deletion, description, listing, tagging, and updating Cloud9 environments.

methods.name: createEnvironmentEC2
methods.description: Creates an EC2 environment in Cloud9.

methods.name: createEnvironmentEC2Async
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an EC2 environment in Cloud9.

methods.name: createEnvironmentMembershipAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new environment member.

methods.name: describeEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Describes the status of an environment.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
